about.title: About, sources and disclaimer
about.disclaimer: Spot, rule and season information is compiled from public sources and is for guidance only. Rules change and differ between fishing districts. The rules on your permit and the fishing club's instructions always apply. Coordinates are approximate – respect private land and protected areas.
about.privacy: We use no tracking cookies and collect no personal data. Your location (the “Near me” button) is used only on your device.
about.contactTitle: Found a mistake or want to suggest a spot?
about.contact: Open an issue on GitHub – every correction is welcome.
